title: Loading Regulations
previewText: Off-street loading berths shall not be permitted between a street wall and a street line. However, the City Planning Commission may authorize off-street loading berths located between a street wall and a street line, provided that the Commission finds that such loading berths can not be located elsewhere on the zoning lot and that such loading berths shall be enclosed or screened to the greatest extent practicable. blocks.html:
1. Off-street loading berths shall not be permitted between a street wall and a street line. However, the City Planning Commission may authorize off-street loading berths located between a street wall and a street line, provided that the Commission finds that such loading berths can not be located elsewhere on the zoning lot and that such loading berths shall be enclosed or screened to the greatest extent practicable.
  2. All open off-street loading berths shall be screened from all adjoining zoning lots pursuant to the standards of Section 44-565 (Screening).
